subject: Pricing gatekeeper: urgent discount approval + forecast update request
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Amy Prescott <amy@neptuneanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@neptuneanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing gatekeeper: urgent discount approval + forecast update request

Hi Amy / Procurement team —

Quick note on the Neptune Analytics renewal (DEAL-4379). Procurement submitted a formal request for a volume-based discount to match their multi-year expansion. They’ve asked for a 28% off list on the 12-month term, which would move the ARR from $1,200,000 to approximately $864,000. The discount request and the supporting business case are attached (neptune_discount_request_v3.pdf).

Karthik / Deal Desk / Finance — could you please:
- Confirm whether we can approve 28% on this account without Exec sign-off
- If approved, confirm the final commit amount we should show in the Q4 forecast (we need the number today)
- If not approved, what is the maximum authorized discount and any recommended counter-offer we should present?

Finance needs to know whether to move this to COMMIT in the forecast. Our current forecast shows it as 70% with a projected close in Oct; moving it to COMMIT will materially change the Q4 commit line.

As a reminder: please don’t mark this as COMMIT in HubSpot (hubspot:deal/HS-987654321) until Deal Desk confirms pricing gate clearance. If we need Exec review, call it out explicitly so we can escalate.

Thanks — I’ll stay on standby to coordinate the DocuSign flow once pricing is locked.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: neptune_discount_request_v3.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Prescott <amy@neptuneanalytics.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@neptuneanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing gatekeeper: urgent discount approval + forecast update request

Thanks Rachel — quick summary from Deal Desk side:
- Neptune is expanding from 4 -> 18 seats and adding dedicated throughput for inference pipelines; they indicated pricing sensitivity and requested 28% off list for the 12-month term.
- Baseline ARR pre-discount: $1,200,000. Requested post-discount ARR: ~$864,000.

Internal note to Finance (Lauren) and RevOps (Ben):
- Our standard approval band allows up to 20% for renewals without Exec sign-off when there’s a strong ROI case. Anything above that typically needs a sales manager + deal desk senior sign-off, and >25% needs CRO/Finance sign-off.
- Can Finance confirm if 25% is the hard threshold for marking as COMMIT in Q4? If not, what discretionary buffer exists for a strategic expansion like this?

If we can offer a 22% counter (final ARR ~$936k) would the commercial team be comfortable? Amy — would a 22% option on a 12-month term with a 30-day SLA uplift be acceptable as a middle ground? If yes, Rachel and I can prepare the redline and the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — I’ll flag this for expedite.

Subject: Re: Pricing gatekeeper: urgent discount approval + forecast update request

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the context. A couple of clarifying Qs before Deal Desk recommends a formal counter:
1) Billing term: is Neptune willing to commit to annual prepay or monthly invoicing? We can be more aggressive on discount for prepaid terms.
2) Effective start date for seat expansion and any ramp credits?

Quick policy reminder (attached: discount-approval-matrix.pdf):
- <= 15%: AE approval
- 16-25%: Sales Manager + Deal Desk
- >25%: CRO + Finance required (exec escalation)

If we accept 22% as Karthik suggested, we still need a written justification (strategic value: reference to expanded throughput + possible marketplace referral) and a single internal approval thread. If Finance (Lauren) signs off now, we can move the HubSpot probability to COMMIT and reflect $936,000 in the Q4 commit line. If Finance requires CRO clearance, do not advance the stage.

(attachment: discount-approval-matrix.pdf)

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of RevOps

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the transparency. A couple quick points from Neptune: 
- We can agree to a 12-month term with annual invoicing (net 30) but prefer a commitment that avoids month-to-month variability.
- The procurement team confirms they can accept a 22% discount if we can lock in the 12-month term and the added throughput by Oct 15.

If Redwood can confirm 22% today, we’ll sign the agreement this week. Please send the DocuSign link and the final commercial redline.

Thanks,
Amy Prescott
Procurement Lead, Neptune Analytics

Marking this as Finance confirmation: after reviewing the business case and expected ARR impact, Finance will approve a 22% discount for Deal Desk to finalize. Exec escalation not required based on strategic expansion and the annual billing commitment.

Please update HubSpot (hubspot:deal/HS-987654321) as follows:
- Stage: COMMIT
- Commit ARR: $936,000
- Close Date: 2026-10-08
- Probability: 100%

Rachel — please proceed to send the DocuSign envelope (https://docusign.com/tx/ABC1234) and attach the final redline. After Amy returns the signed documents, RevOps will book the order and Finance will reflect the change in the Q4 commit instantly.

Closing notes: if any party later requests a deeper concession (term extensions, additional seat credits), re-open this thread and include Finance before altering the commit.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
